name: DeceptionDecoded
note: 12K image-caption pairs grounded in trustworthy reference articles; focuses on misleading creator intent.

name: DriftBench
note: 16K instances across six GenAI diversification categories; explicitly targets model/evidence drift robustness.

name: FakeVE
note: 2,672 fake-news video posts with natural-language explanations covering four deceptive aspects.

name: FineFake
note: 16,909 samples across 6 topics and 8 platforms; includes semi-manually verified knowledge.

name: ReMMDBench
note: 500 real-world samples with 2,756 images, multi-image posts, multilingual settings, provenance and rationales.

name: VLDBench
note: ~62K labeled text-image pairs across 13 categories from 58 news sources; expert-reviewed human-AI annotation.

name: AMG
note: 4,922 samples; labels cover real, image fabrication, entity/event/time-space inconsistency, and ineffective visual information.

name: MFND
note: Designed around 11 manipulated types and joint detection/localization; total size should be cited from the released version when fixed.

name: MM-Health
note: 34,746 health articles: 5,776 human-generated and 28,880 AI-generated multimodal items.

name: MMFakeBench
note: 11,000 pairs: 1,000 validation + 10,000 test; covers textual, visual, and cross-modal distortions.

name: FakeTT
note: English TikTok benchmark with 1,991 videos across 286 events.

name: MiRAGeNews
note: 15K multimodal news pairs with out-of-domain test sets for unseen publishers and generators.

name: M³A
note: Reports 708K genuine and >6M generated/manipulated variants; avoid summing as if all are independent real-world posts.

name: VERITE
note: Balanced truthful/miscaptioned/OOC benchmark designed to reduce unimodal bias.

name: COSMOS
note: OOC image-caption benchmark; 204,458 images and 454,185 captions.

name: DGM⁴
note: 77,426 pristine and 152,574 manipulated news image-text pairs; supports binary detection, manipulation-type classification, image-region grounding, and text-token grounding.

name: FACTIFY 2
note: Adds satire and finer multimodal relation labels.

name: FakeSV
note: 3,654 fake/real videos plus 1,884 debunking videos.

name: MOCHEG
note: SIGIR 2023 Best Paper Honorable Mention; supports end-to-end evidence retrieval, verification, and explanation.

name: MR²
note: English and Chinese subsets; labels are non-rumor, rumor, and unverified with retrieved evidence.

name: FACTIFY
note: Claim/reference multimodal verification dataset; repo software license should not be assumed to cover all media.

name: MuMiN
note: 12,914 claims linked to ~21.6M tweets; claim count is the appropriate primary sample size.

name: CHECKED
note: 2,104 verified COVID-19 microblogs with rich propagation and multimedia context.

name: NewsCLIPpings
note: Automatically constructs hard image-caption mismatches from VisualNews.

name: VisualNews
label_type: paired image-caption and article text (no veracity label)
note: 1,080,595 news images paired with captions and articles from The Guardian, BBC, USA Today, and The Washington Post; includes author and other metadata.

name: Weibo21
note: Chinese multi-domain benchmark with 9 semantic domains.

name: Fakeddit
note: Classic large-scale multimodal benchmark; paper experiments often use the multimodal subset.

name: MM-COVID
note: Multilingual COVID-19 disinformation resource; Twitter data is distributed via IDs.

name: NYTimes800k
label_type: paired image-caption and article text (no veracity label)
note: 792,971 New York Times images with captions from 444,914 articles spanning 14 years; includes image locations within article text and associated visual features.

name: FakeNewsNet
note: Includes PolitiFact and GossipCop; full raw content is reconstructed because of platform/copyright constraints.

name: Weibo Multimodal Rumor Dataset
note: Classic Chinese image-text rumor dataset; 4,749 rumor and 4,779 non-rumor posts.
